experiments.note: This view shows 36 scored readings and 72 forecasts from a completed 39-reading test: 16 new colors measured twice, plus four familiar returns. There were no surrounding-image tests here; three unscored white, blue and green check readings are outside this view and remain retained with the full result. Examples matched by the proportions of the display's six color states met the chosen DeltaE00 limit of 1 on 23/32 new readings (11/16 colors in both repeats), versus 14/32 (7/16) for examples matched by the requested color. Both methods missed the complete test requirement. Each met the limit on all four familiar returns, reported separately. Use the color selector to inspect both readings and their individual errors.

experiments.note: This view shows 36 scored readings and 72 forecasts from a completed 39-reading test: 16 test patterns measured twice, plus four familiar returns. The three unscored white, blue and green check readings remain retained outside this view. Expanding the prediction library from 33 to 49 measured examples lowered mean error on the 32 test-pattern readings from 1.68 to 0.95 DeltaE00 and worst error from 6.33 to 2.08. Both models met the chosen limit of 1 on both readings of 7 of 16 patterns. Four patterns gained a pass and four lost one. Both forecasts failed the complete requirement. The familiar warm color failed its first reading and passed its later reading with both models; those returns are reported separately. Use the color selector to inspect every individual result.

experiments.condition: Contact i1Pro 3, a fixed measurement position, 30-second waits after display updates and unchanged declared contact and instrument angle. Both centers are the identical 64×64 native square [368,158,432,222), not an optical aperture. Cypresses keeps its original image and padding. Graphics is translated (+32,-82) and cropped without interpolation or redithering: 78,336 white-fill pixels cover 20.4% of the full frame, with zero fill in the 4,096 center pixels. Within the interleaved session, Cypresses followed image–control–control–image and graphics followed control–image–image–control. The intervening display histories differed. Temperatures are sensor-local, not panel temperatures or an explanation of the differences.
experiments.convention: i1Pro 3 reflectance factor in percent. XYZ and Lab use nominal perfect-diffuser D50 where retained; no measured-media-white conversion is applied here.
experiments.note: Do identical center pixels give the same measured color when an image's surroundings become white? These eight fresh readings compare two images with their matched-center controls, twice each. Both pairs missed the predeclared agreement target: maximum image/control DeltaE00 was 3.333 for Cypresses and 1.510 for graphics, against an inclusive limit of 1. Each maximum uses four dependent contrasts sharing the same readings, not four independent repetitions. Repeat movements and descriptive mean differences are shown separately; neither replaces the criterion. The result is a configuration-associated difference, not a cause, an image-wide accuracy test or a measured optical footprint.

experiments.condition: The displayed pixel patterns and forecasts were unchanged. The contact i1Pro 3 measured at a fixed position after 30-second waits. Patterns were selected using earlier results, so this was not a test on new inputs and does not demonstrate a general learning curve. Better predictions did not establish better rendered images. The check readings were not used to normalize the results. Temperatures are sensor readings, not panel temperatures or an explanation of the color changes.
experiments.convention: i1Pro 3 reflectance factor in percent. XYZ and Lab use nominal perfect-diffuser D50 where retained; no measured-media-white conversion is applied here.
experiments.note: Six selected known patterns were each measured six times: twice early, twice in the middle and twice late. This view includes all 39 physical readings: 36 scored returns with 72 forecasts, plus three unscored white, blue and green check readings. The expanded library met the chosen DeltaE00 limit of 1 on 27/36 readings, versus 12/36 for the baseline; mean error was 0.786 versus 2.220 and worst error 1.569 versus 6.686. It passed both readings of 12/18 pairs of readings taken close together, versus 6/18, and all six returns of 3/6 patterns, versus 2/6. Both forecasts failed the complete all-reading requirement. Familiar warm light passed all six readings with identical predictions from both models, separately from the five other known patterns. Select a pattern to inspect its six returns and both forecasts; small misses just above 1 remain outside the chosen limit.
